messages:
anya: heads-up — publish pipeline hit a blocker on the typegen/regendiff step. regen produced a minor version bump in js-sdk (0.3.2 -> 0.4.0) but CHANGELOG.md is untouched, so publish-gate rejected it. also the sample-app auth flow started failing in e2e after pulling the regen artifacts.

devon: ugh, saw that in CI. failing job: //devex/publish:js-sdk-publish. ci log excerpt:
```
ci-bot: publish check failed: regendiff detected 1 file with semver-major/minor changes: packages/js-sdk/package.json (version changed)
ERROR: changelog missing for bumped versions. publish-gate aborting.
```

marco: any idea what in typegen caused the version bump? nothing in openapi schemas changed AFAIK.

anya: my local run shows typegen changed the enum ordering in generated client and that triggered the semver bump rule. I think the typegen default sort is non-deterministic on some platforms which flipped an enum order -> perceived API surface change.

sam: hmm. we've seen nondet ordering before. can you paste the specific diff?

anya: sure:
```
-  "enum": ["alpha","beta","gamma"]
+  "enum": ["beta","alpha","gamma"]
```
No API contract change, just ordering. typegen then normalizes and bumped minor because our semver bot treats any enum ordering diff as public-surface change.

linh: that's the DX auth/retry parity angle — sample-app fails because the regenerated client now encodes header ordering slightly differently and our retry wrapper mis-parses a 401 -> infinite retry loop in dev mode. Not ideal.

devon: ok, two separate problems: (1) nondet enum ordering in typegen causing spurious semver bumps, (2) sample-app's auth wrapper being fragile to header shape changes. For 1, we can add a stable sort flag to typegen invocation. For 2, we should make auth/retry parse tolerant.

marco: quick mitigation: revert the version bump and skip the semver check until we land a stable-sort hotfix. We should avoid skipping long — only for this patch.

sam: PR suggestion: anya, can you open a tiny PR that (a) runs typegen with --stable-sort and (b) reinstates the original package.json version (and add a NOTE in CI job to re-evaluate once stable-sort is merged)?

anya: will do. also I'll add a changelog entry explaining the nondet ordering and that it's a regen-only normalization.

ci-bot: @devex FYI there's a flaky job we can re-run once PR lands: //devex/publish:js-sdk-publish (rerun with `runtool retry 3519876543`).

linh: I'll tidy the auth wrapper in sample-app to treat auth headers as case-insensitive and guard the retry logic so 401 leads to single reauth attempt then fail (no infinite loops). cc @sam for review.

devon: plan sounds good. owners: anya for typegen fix + PR, linh for auth/retry fix. sam will coordinate the temporary semver gate bypass if needed.

marco: can we add a unit test to ensure enum ordering changes don't trigger semver bumps? maybe a golden file comparison with normalized sort.

anya: yes i can add a golden regen test that runs typegen with deterministic env and asserts sorted enums. putting that in the PR.

sam: thanks. once PR lands, I'll re-run CI. if anything else pops up, post the regendiff output here. :thumbsup:

anya: pushing PR now. PR link: (internal) — will paste CI rerun when available.

devon: thanks team — quick note for the future: maybe relax semver bot for pure-format-only diffs, or we need a more nuanced detection rule. filing a follow-up issue after this resolves.

linh: created a tiny patch in sample-app and will open PR for auth guard.

ci-bot: action required: rerun //devex/publish:js-sdk-publish after both PRs merged.

anya: ack. I'll follow up when CI is green.
